item.title: SHAFT 0.73.0
item.description:
• Meetings window: choose the account a meeting belongs to and its title, so the instances you granted can read it.
  • Copy Reference: copies a line to paste into a chat that points the instance at that meeting.
  • Settings → Access: a Meetings row per Google account to let an instance read that account's meetings.
  • With a single Google account, new recordings are filed under it automatically.
  • Filing a meeting that is already transcribed sends its note to the instances watching meetings.
